description: Servo amplitude-bandwidth ladder: 5-15 deg rungs. Each rung is a fixed-amplitude linear PRPS block (top freq = min(0.90*f_slew(theta), 15.0 Hz coherence ceiling)) plus single-tone slew probes on rungs whose knee f_slew = slew_est/(2*pi*theta) <= 15.0 Hz. slew_est 900 deg/s, corner 9.0 Hz (measured from the 2026-06-29 upgraded-servo step test). Maps f_vec(theta) = min(linear corner, slew knee) to invert the feasibility thrust trade.
